task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

calls.candidate: hard Existence(target_picked_up), hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key), soft Absence(key_lost), soft Response(has_door_key, door_open)
calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires opening the door with the key before picking up the box, but the only hard order clause is Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key). The Response from has_door_key to door_open is soft, so it does not enforce the commanded sequence. Add hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up); with the existing hard Existence(target_picked_up), these orders also force the earlier steps.
